d: The Trail Blazers defeated the Kings, 120-107 tonight in Sacramento. Deni Avdija contributed a team-high 34 points to go with 6 rebounds 4 assists and 3 three pointers, with Damian Lillard of the Trail Blazers adding an additional 29 points (6-18 FG, 6-13 3P) in the game. De'Andre Hunter finished with a team-high 24 points along with 5 rebounds for the Kings in the losing effort. The Trail Blazers improve their record to 9-3 with the win, while the Kings fall to 1-11 for the season.
